name: Arguing
overview: Scripture warns against engaging in needless arguments, especially with those who have not wronged us, emphasizing that contention arises from pride rather than wisdom. A gentle response can defuse anger, while harsh words only provoke it. The wise exercise restraint in speech and avoid matching folly with folly, recognizing that impulsive outbursts reveal foolishness rather than strength. True wisdom calls for measured, thoughtful interaction rather than contentious disputes.
